# Recreation Prompt

Create a single-page mobile portrait browser game called **Swamp Ogre Slayventure** based on this steering prompt: Shrek fairy-tale parody adventure. A Shrek fairy-tale parody adventure game with swampy irreverence, oddball friendship, anti-princess humor, pop-culture jokes, chaotic charm, and lovable gross-out fantasy with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

Preserve the source mechanics: real-time canvas arena action, joystick movement, tap/light attack, held heavy attack, dash/roll, inventory equipment selection, enemy waves, collision damage, loot drops, score/currency, upgrades, game-over and restart. Transform presentation into a swampy fairy-tale parody: green ogre antihero, gross onion/frog/dragon loot, royal/fairy-tale heckler enemies, mud-and-reed scene ownership, comic HUD copy, punchy mobile controls, and readable portrait-first UI.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source game truth
The original public surface is a single-page canvas action RPG. It starts directly into play, uses a virtual joystick for movement, canvas tap for light attack, a held heavy-attack button, a roll/dash button, and an inventory/equipment panel. Enemies spawn from the edges, chase or vary motion by type, collide with the player for HP damage, and can be defeated for score/currency, loot, upgrades, and weapon unlocks. Failure occurs when HP reaches zero and exposes a restart overlay.

## Protected mechanics
- Real-time update/render loop and canvas playfield.
- Joystick movement, facing direction, tap attack, held heavy attack, roll cooldown/distance, inventory/equipment buttons, keyboard fallbacks.
- Enemy spawn cadence, wave escalation, contact damage, HP and game-over semantics.
- Attack range/damage/cooldown profiles, loot levels, gold progression, weapon unlock thresholds.

## Safe transformation surfaces
World copy, HUD vocabulary, color system, procedural drawing functions, background scene identity, monster/player silhouettes, audio/GIF feedback labels, and mobile panel styling are safe to transform.

## Remix blueprint
Rebuild the game as **Swamp Ogre Slayventure**, a mobile portrait fairy-tale parody action RPG where a lovable swamp ogre bonks royal nonsense, gathers gross swamp loot, and survives increasingly chaotic chapters.
